data.name: Draconid
data.description:
The Neutrals - Draconid [E]
Units:
+5% attack rate

Buildings:
+20% damage
-5% cost
-12.5% mana

Upgrades:
-1Lv Magic
+10% research speed

Magic:
Fire Bolt (Stuns the target for 3 seconds)
Reinforcements (Summons Lizardman Warrior for 20 seconds)

Traits: Draconid are mortals empowered by the dragons they serve. This faction is great in the early game but due to the lack of magic, it starts to lose heavily later on. Strong heroes that constantly increase their power are the key to dominating the map.

Difficulty: Advanced
Created: by Ksay
Reworked: by Yoba

spells.name: CATACLYSM
spells.description:
Void Rift appears in the middle of the map and belongs to you. Initially it has no power and needs empowerment.

Rift's Favor:
Heroes present near the Rift take control of it, granting it's power to owner of Hero. If 2 different Heroes are present, the Rift will switch sides randomly every 10s. If none are present, the Rift belongs to whoever last controlled it

Abilities:
The Awakening (Damage Spell)
Requirements: Dragon Keep Lv 1)
Deals 100-300 damage in a line every 180-60 seconds
(3000 range)

Power of the Rift (Support Aura)
Requirements: Dragon Keep Lv 2)
4-8 HP bonus regeneration
(3000 range)

Rift Strike (Damage Spell)
Requirements: Dragon Keep Lv 3)
Every 2 min, deal 1000 dmg to random enemy building

Abilities improve with Dragon Keep
